title: The Good Shepherd, I and the Father Are One

questions.question: Jesus said anyone who does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in another way is what?
questions.explanation: John 10:1 (ESV): "Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in by another way, that man is a thief and a robber."

questions.question: "I am the _____. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved and will go in and out and find pasture." What belongs in the blank?
questions.explanation: John 10:9 (ESV): "I am the door. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved and will go in and out and find pasture."

questions.question: "The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life and have it..."?
questions.explanation: John 10:10 (ESV): "The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life and have it abundantly."

questions.question: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for..."?
questions.explanation: John 10:11 (ESV): "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep."

questions.question: What does the hired hand do when he sees the wolf coming?
options: He leaves the sheep and flees
He fights until the master purely arrives
He sounds a horn securely for help
He throws stones completely at it
questions.correctAnswer: He leaves the sheep and flees
questions.explanation: John 10:12 (ESV): "He who is a hired hand and not a shepherd... sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees"

questions.question: Why does the Father love Jesus in relation to the sheep, according to John 10:17?
options: "For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life that I may take it up again."
"Because I perfectly keep the sheep from harm entirely."
"Because I heal the broken lambs safely."
"Because I carry purely their burdens completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life that I may take it up again."
questions.explanation: John 10:17 (ESV): "For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life that I may take it up again."

questions.question: Does anyone take Jesus' life from Him forcefully?
options: "No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord."
"The Romans will take it entirely forcefully."
"The Jews strictly demand it of him."
questions.correctAnswer: "No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord."
questions.explanation: John 10:18 (ESV): "No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again."

questions.question: Jesus was walking in the temple during the Feast of Dedication. What time of year was it?
options: It was the spring harvest securely
questions.explanation: John 10:22 (ESV): "At that time the Feast of Dedication took place at Jerusalem. It was winter,"

questions.question: When the Jews asked Jesus to tell them plainly if He is the Christ, why did Jesus say they did not believe?
options: "but you do not believe because you are not among my sheep."
"because you strictly wait for a king securely."
"because your hearts are heavily hardened completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "but you do not believe because you are not among my sheep."
questions.explanation: John 10:26 (ESV): "but you do not believe because you are not among my sheep."

questions.question: Jesus stated: "My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will..."?
questions.explanation: John 10:27-28 (ESV): "My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand."

questions.question: What monumental claim did Jesus make summarizing His absolute unity with God?
options: "I and the Father safely rule completely."
"The Father has made purely an heir securely."
"The Father speaks plainly through my mouth."
questions.explanation: John 10:30 (ESV): "I and the Father are one."

questions.question: When Jesus stated "I and the Father are one", what was the immediate reaction of the Jews?
options: They picked up stones again to stone him
They fell safely to their faces in fear
They laughed securely and walked purely away
questions.correctAnswer: They picked up stones again to stone him
questions.explanation: John 10:31 (ESV): "The Jews picked up stones again to stone him."

questions.question: They told Jesus they were not stoning Him for a good work, but for what reason specifically?
options: "For blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God."
"For leading strictly the people safely astray."
questions.correctAnswer: "For blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God."
questions.explanation: John 10:33 (ESV): "The Jews answered him, 'It is not for a good work that we are going to stone you but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.'"

questions.question: Jesus answered them by interestingly quoting their own Law (Psalm 82:6), saying: "Is it not written in your Law, 'I said, you are...'"?
questions.explanation: John 10:34 (ESV): "Jesus answered them, 'Is it not written in your Law, "I said, you are gods"?'"

questions.question: Jesus challenged them: "If I am not doing the works of my Father, then do not believe me; but if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the..."?
options: "...works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father."
questions.correctAnswer: "...works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father."
questions.explanation: John 10:38 (ESV): "but if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father."

key_verse_text: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep."
